attributes.name: Ghoul Hide
attributes.powers:
If this card has the Corrupted trait, bury a random card from your discard pile or you may not play this card.

Recharge this card to reduce Cold or Combat damage dealt to you by 2, or to ignore a bane's effect that causes you to end your turn.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
